about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Spiced Onion Omelette on Buttered Toast
recipes.summary: Spiced egg omelette with onion, tomato and green chilli, folded onto buttered toast.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the onion, tomato, chilli, turmeric, garam masala, coriander and salt.
Melt half the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in half the mixture. Cook 2 minutes each side until set through and golden.
Repeat with the remaining mixture until set, then toast the bread until golden, spread with the remaining butter and serve the omelettes on the toast.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until firm with no runny egg.

recipes.title: Vegan Semolina Upma Breakfast Pots
recipes.summary: Toasted semolina cooked with mustard seed, curry leaf and peas into a soft, savoury breakfast.
steps: Toast the semolina in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes until fragrant, then tip out.
Heat the oil in the same pan and fry the mustard seed and curry leaf until they pop. Add the onion, chilli and ginger and cook 4 minutes.
Pour in the water, add the peas and salt, and bring to the boil until bubbling.
Stir in the semolina in a steady stream, stirring constantly, then cover on low heat for 3 minutes until thick and fluffy.
Finish with lemon juice and serve hot.

recipes.title: Besan Chilla Vegan Pancakes
recipes.summary: Savoury chickpea flour pancakes with onion, tomato and coriander, naturally gluten free.
steps: Whisk the flour, water, turmeric, cumin, chilli powder and salt into a smooth batter, then fold through the onion, tomato and coriander.
Heat a little oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in a ladle of batter, spreading thin.
Cook 3 minutes until the underside is golden, flip and cook 2 minutes more until cooked through.
Repeat with the remaining batter and serve warm.

recipes.title: Rava Uttapam with Tomato and Peas
recipes.summary: Thick South Indian semolina pancakes topped with tomato, peas and coriander.
steps: Mix the semolina, yoghurt, water and salt into a thick batter and rest 15 minutes, then stir in the bicarbonate of soda.
Heat a little oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in a thick ladle of batter.
Scatter over the tomato, peas, chilli and coriander and press in lightly.
Cook 4 minutes, flip and cook 3 minutes more until golden and cooked through. Repeat with remaining batter.
notes: Plus 15 minutes resting the batter.

recipes.title: Spiced Flatbread Scramble with Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Torn flatbread fried in spiced butter with onion and tomato, served with cool yoghurt.
steps: Tear the flatbread into bite-sized pieces.
Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat and fry the onion 3 minutes. Add the paprika, cumin, cardamom and chilli flakes and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the tomato and cook 2 minutes, then toss through the flatbread and salt for 3 minutes until crisp at the edges.
Serve topped with yoghurt and parsley.

recipes.title: Eggs on Spiced Tomato Flatbread
recipes.summary: Eggs baked in a cumin and paprika tomato base, scooped up with flatbread.
steps: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat and soften the onion and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, paprika, cumin and salt and simmer 6 minutes until thick.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 4 to 5 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter with coriander and serve with the flatbread.
notes: Food safety: cook until the whites are fully set; do not serve runny eggs to young children, pregnant women or older people.

recipes.title: Mealie Pap Porridge with Cinnamon Apple
recipes.summary: Creamy maize porridge topped with butter-braised apple and cinnamon.
steps: Bring the milk, water and salt to a simmer in a saucepan until steaming.
Whisk in the polenta and cook over low heat, stirring often, for 15 minutes until thick and creamy.
Meanwhile melt the butter in a small pan and cook the apple with the sugar and cinnamon for 8 minutes until soft.
Spoon the porridge into bowls and top with the apple.

recipes.title: Roosterkoek Grilled Bread Rolls with Cheddar
recipes.summary: Soft yeasted rolls browned on the grill and filled with melted cheddar and tomato.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, then add the water and oil and knead 8 minutes until smooth.
Cover and prove 45 minutes until doubled, then shape into 8 flat rolls and rest 10 minutes.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan over medium heat for 6 to 7 minutes each side until golden and hollow when tapped.
Split, butter, then fill with cheddar and tomato and grill until melted.
notes: Plus about 55 minutes proving and resting.

recipes.title: Tapsilog Beef and Egg Rice Plates
recipes.summary: Soy-calamansi style marinated beef strips with garlic rice and a fried egg.
steps: Marinate the beef with the soy sauce, lime juice, 1 garlic clove and pepper.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy. Fry the remaining garlic in half the oil until golden and fold through the rice.
Sear the beef in a hot pan 2 minutes each side until browned and cooked through to at least 63°C inside, then rest briefly.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set and serve with the beef, garlic rice and tomato.
notes: Food safety: cook steak strips to at least 63°C (75°C for mince) and keep raw meat away from ready foods. Cook eggs until the whites are set.
Plus 30 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Curry Egg Roti Pockets
recipes.summary: Roti folded around a spiced egg and onion filling.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes, then stir in the curry powder and chilli for 1 minute.
Beat the eggs with the salt and pour in. Stir gently for 3 minutes until just firm, then add the coriander.
Warm the roti in a dry pan 30 seconds each side.
Spoon the egg onto the roti, fold in the sides and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until firm with no liquid egg left.

recipes.title: Martabak Telur Egg and Onion Parcels
recipes.summary: Crisp parcels of wrapper filled with spiced egg, spring onion and onion.
steps: Beat the eggs with the spring onion, onion, curry powder, salt and pepper.
Lay a wrapper flat, pour a quarter of the mixture into the centre and fold the corners in to make a square parcel.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry the parcels seam-side down for 3 minutes each side until golden and the egg is set.
Cut into squares and serve hot.
notes: Food safety: cook until the egg is fully set.

recipes.title: Thai Omelette with Jasmine Rice
recipes.summary: Puffy deep-fried style omelette with fish sauce and lime over steamed rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Beat the eggs with the fish sauce, lime juice and spring onion.
Heat the oil in a small wok until very hot and pour in the egg, letting it puff and crisp.
Cook 1 minute, flip and cook 1 minute more until golden and set.
Serve over rice with sriracha.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg until fully set.

recipes.title: Pâté Baguette with Pan-Fried Eggs and Soy
recipes.summary: Eggs fried in a pan with pâté, soy and spring onion, served with a crusty baguette.
steps: Warm the baguette and split it, spreading the pâté inside.
Melt the butter in a small frying pan over medium heat. Crack in the eggs and cook 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Splash over the soy sauce and scatter with spring onion and pepper.
Serve straight from the pan with the baguette and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set.

recipes.title: Korean Potato Hash Rounds
recipes.summary: Crisp grated potato rounds with spring onion and a gochujang-sesame dip.
steps: Grate the potatoes, squeeze out as much liquid as you can and mix with the spring onion, egg, starch and salt.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry heaped spoonfuls, pressed flat, for 4 minutes each side until deep golden and cooked through.
Mix the gochujang, vinegar and sesame oil for dipping.
notes: Food safety: cook until the egg is set.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Rice Porridge with Sesame
recipes.summary: Soft rice and sweet potato congee finished with toasted sesame and a little soy.
steps: Simmer the rice, water and ginger in a pot over medium-low heat for 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the sweet potato and cook 15 minutes more until the porridge is thick and the potato soft.
Toast the sesame seed in a dry pan for 2 minutes.
Ladle into bowls and top with the sesame, spring onion, soy sauce and sesame oil.

recipes.title: Okayu Rice Porridge with Furikake Egg
recipes.summary: Plain Japanese rice porridge topped with a soft-set egg and furikake.
steps: Rinse the rice and simmer in the water over low heat, partly covered, for 25 minutes until thick and creamy.
Meanwhile boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Ladle the porridge into bowls, halve the eggs on top and finish with furikake, soy sauce and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: use fresh eggs; the yolk will be soft but the white should be set.

recipes.title: Miso Butter Mushroom Toast
recipes.summary: Seared mushrooms in miso butter piled on thick toast with spring onion.
steps: Sear the mushrooms in a dry pan over high heat for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the butter, miso, soy sauce and garlic and cook 2 minutes more until glossy.
Toast the sourdough until golden and spoon the mushrooms on top.
Finish with spring onion and pepper.

recipes.title: Steamed Egg and Pork Rice Plates
recipes.summary: Silky steamed eggs with savoury minced pork over rice.
steps: Mix the pork with the soy sauce and sesame oil and spread in a shallow heatproof dish.
Beat the eggs with the water and salt, strain, and pour over the pork.
Cover the dish tightly and steam over simmering water for 15 minutes until the egg is just set and the pork reaches 75°C.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy and serve topped with the steamed egg and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork mince to 75°C with no pink, and make sure the egg is fully set.

recipes.title: Kenyan Spiced Potato Mashed Bread Wraps
recipes.summary: Chapati wraps filled with turmeric potato, peas and fresh tomato.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes until tender, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes. Drain.
Fry the onion in the oil for 4 minutes, add the turmeric and cumin and stir 30 seconds.
Add the potatoes, peas, tomato and salt, mash roughly, and cook 3 minutes. Stir in the coriander and lemon juice.
Warm the roti, fill with the potato mix and roll up.

recipes.title: Kachumbari Beef Samosa Pockets
recipes.summary: Crisp baked pastry pockets with spiced beef mince and a tomato-onion relish.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes, add the mince and spices and cook 8 minutes, breaking up, until browned and cooked through at 75°C. Cool.
Fold the wrappers into triangles around the filling and brush the edges with a little water to seal.
Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until golden and crisp.
Mix the tomato, red onion, lime juice and coriander and serve alongside.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef mince to 75°C with no pink before wrapping, and cool it quickly.

recipes.title: Pilau Beef Rice Lunch Pot
recipes.summary: Fragrant Swahili-style spiced rice with tender beef and caramelised onion.
steps: Brown the onion in the oil over medium heat for 10 minutes until deep golden.
Add the beef, garlic, ginger and spices and sear 5 minutes.
Add the stock and salt, cover and simmer 25 minutes until the beef is tender.
Stir in the rice, cover and cook on low for 12 minutes until the rice is tender and the beef reaches at least 75°C inside, then rest 5 minutes.
notes: Food safety: cook diced beef to at least 75°C inside; refrigerate leftovers within an hour.

recipes.title: Chickpea Coconut Curry Wraps
recipes.summary: Creamy coconut chickpeas with tomato and coriander wrapped in warm flatbread.
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder and tomato and cook 3 minutes, then add the chickpeas, coconut milk and salt.
Simmer 8 minutes until thick, then stir in the coriander.
Spoon into warmed flatbread and roll up.

recipes.title: Samp and Beans Lunch Bowls
recipes.summary: Hearty maize and bean bowls with tomato, onion and a little chilli.
steps: Bring the water and salt to the boil, whisk in the polenta and cook on low 15 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Meanwhile fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, add the paprika and curry powder, then the tomatoes.
Simmer 8 minutes, add the beans and heat through.
Spoon the polenta into bowls, ladle over the beans and scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Fried Bread Balls with Curried Beef Mince
recipes.summary: Golden fried bread balls split and filled with a mild curried beef mince.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt with the warm water into a soft dough, knead 5 minutes, cover and prove 45 minutes.
Cook the onion in a little oil for 4 minutes, add the mince and curry powder and brown 8 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste and water and simmer 10 minutes until cooked through at 75°C.
Shape the dough into 8 balls and fry in shallow oil over medium heat for 8 minutes, turning, until deep golden and cooked inside.
Split each vetkoek and fill with the mince.
notes: Food safety: cook the mince to 75°C with no pink.
Plus about 45 minutes proving.

recipes.title: Biltong-Free Chicken Mayo Lunch Rolls
recipes.summary: Poached chicken with spring onion and mayonnaise in soft rolls with lettuce.
steps: Simmer the chicken in water for 15 minutes until the juices run clear and the thickest part reaches 75°C. Cool and shred.
Mix the chicken with the mayonnaise, spring onion, mustard powder, lemon juice and pepper.
Fill the rolls with lettuce, tomato and the chicken mix.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C before shredding; keep filled rolls refrigerated until serving.

recipes.title: Crisp Chopped Chicken Sisig Plates
recipes.summary: Chopped crisp-edged chicken thigh with onion, chilli and lime over rice, topped with an egg.
steps: Grill or pan-fry the chicken 8 minutes each side over medium-high until browned and 75°C at the thickest point. Rest, then chop finely.
Fry the chopped chicken in the oil in a hot pan for 4 minutes until crisp at the edges.
Toss with the onion, chilli, soy, lime juice and mayonnaise.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, fry the eggs and serve on top.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C throughout and fry the eggs until whites are set.

recipes.title: Filipino Egg Rolls with Pork
recipes.summary: Crisp lumpia rolls of pork mince, carrot and onion.
steps: Mix the pork with the carrot, onion, garlic, spring onion and soy sauce.
Place a spoonful on each wrapper, roll tightly and seal the edge with a dab of water.
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes, turning, until golden and the pork reaches 75°C inside.
Drain and serve with the sweet chilli sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork to 75°C throughout; cut one roll open to check no pink remains.

recipes.title: Filipino Chicken Pastel Hand Pies
recipes.summary: Flaky pies of creamy chicken, potato, carrot and peas.
steps: Melt the butter, cook the onion 4 minutes, add the chicken and brown 6 minutes.
Add the flour, then the milk gradually, with the potato, carrot and salt. Simmer 10 minutes until thick and the chicken is cooked through at 75°C. Add the peas and cool.
Cut the pastry into 8 squares, fill 4, top with the rest and seal. Brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 200°C for 20 to 25 minutes until puffed and golden.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken to 75°C before filling, and cool the filling quickly.

recipes.title: Calamansi-Style Chicken Adobo Rice Plates
recipes.summary: Gluten-free adobo of chicken in tamari, coconut vinegar, garlic and bay leaf.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a pot over medium-high heat for 6 minutes.
Add the tamari, vinegar, garlic, bay and pepper with 1/2 cup water, cover and simmer 25 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C.
Uncover and reduce the liquid for 5 minutes until glossy.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy and serve with the chicken.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until 75°C throughout.

recipes.title: Pork Bistek Style Tamari Pork and Onions
recipes.summary: Tender pork slices with lime and tamari over onion rings, gluten free.
steps: Marinate the pork in the tamari, lime juice and garlic.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Sear the onions in half the oil for 5 minutes and set aside.
Cook the pork in the remaining oil for 6 minutes with the marinade until no pink remains and it reaches 70°C, then return the onions.
notes: Food safety: cook fresh pork to 70°C with no pink remaining.
Plus 30 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Rendang Daging Slow Beef
recipes.summary: Beef simmered in coconut milk, lemongrass and chilli until dark, dry and intensely rich.
steps: Blend the garlic, shallots, galangal, ginger and soaked chillies to a paste.
Toast the desiccated coconut in a dry pan until deep golden.
Add the paste, coconut milk, lemongrass, lime leaves, spices and beef to a heavy pot and simmer, stirring, for 2 hours.
Stir in the coconut, sugar and salt and cook until the sauce is dry and clinging, about 20 minutes.
Check the beef is tender and has passed 75°C inside, then serve.
notes: Food safety: braise diced beef until tender and well past 75°C inside.

recipes.title: Ayam Percik Grilled Coconut Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken thighs grilled with a lemongrass and turmeric coconut baste, gluten free.
steps: Blend the lemongrass, ginger, garlic, shallots and spices with half the coconut milk and marinate the chicken.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Grill the chicken 12 minutes each side, basting with the remaining coconut milk, until browned and 75°C.
Stir the tamari and sugar into the leftover marinade and simmer 5 minutes, then spoon over the chicken.
notes: Food safety: boil the leftover marinade 5 minutes before using as a glaze, and cook chicken to 75°C.
Plus 1 hour marinating.

recipes.title: Malaysian Kapitan Chicken Curry
recipes.summary: Mild coconut chicken curry with lemongrass, turmeric and lime leaves.
steps: Blend the onion, garlic and ginger to a paste and fry in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder and chicken and brown 5 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, lemongrass and lime leaves and simmer 25 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C.
Finish with lime juice and serve with cooked jasmine rice.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken thigh to 75°C throughout.

recipes.title: Apricot Cinnamon Chicken Curry Pot
recipes.summary: Gently spiced chicken curry with apricot, tomato and cinnamon.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes and set aside.
Fry the onion, garlic and ginger 5 minutes, add the curry powder and cinnamon.
Return the chicken, add the tomatoes, apricot and salt, cover and simmer 30 minutes until 75°C at the thickest part.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy and serve alongside.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C throughout.

recipes.title: Mozambican Peri-Peri Prawns with Rice
recipes.summary: Garlicky chilli-lemon prawns over steamed rice, gluten free.
steps: Toss the prawns with the garlic, chilli, lemon juice, paprika and oil.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Sear the prawns in a hot pan 2 to 3 minutes each side until opaque and curled.
Serve over rice with parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until opaque and pink all the way through.

recipes.title: Durban Chickpea Curry with Rice
recipes.summary: Spicy tomato chickpea curry, vegan and gluten free.
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil 5 minutes, add the curry powder.
Add tomatoes, potato, chickpeas, salt and 1 cup water and simmer 25 minutes until potato is tender.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Scatter with the coriander and serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Kenyan Plantain and Beef Stew
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked beef with green plantain, tomato and coriander, gluten free.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil 8 minutes.
Add onion, garlic and ginger and cook 4 minutes, then tomato, spices and salt.
Cover with water, simmer 30 minutes, add plantain and cook 15 minutes more until beef is tender and above 75°C.
Scatter with the coriander and serve hot with plenty of the juices.
notes: Food safety: cook beef cubes to at least 75°C inside.

recipes.title: Tomato Coconut Fish Pot with Chilli and Lemon
recipes.summary: White fish in a coconut-tomato base with lemon and chilli, gluten free.

items: 600g white fish fillet, cut in chunks

steps: Fry the onion, garlic and chilli in the oil 5 minutes, then add tomato and coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Add the fish and simmer 5 minutes until opaque and flaking.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander.
notes: Food safety: fish is done when opaque and flakes easily.

recipes.title: Tandoori Fish Tikka with Basmati
recipes.summary: Yoghurt and spice marinated fish pieces, grilled and served with basmati rice, gluten free.

items: 600g white fish fillet, cut in chunks

steps: Mix the yoghurt, spices, ginger garlic paste, lemon juice and oil and coat the fish.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Grill or pan-sear 3 to 4 minutes each side until opaque and flaking.
Serve over rice with coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook until opaque and flaking.
Plus 30 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Cardamom Butter Chicken Pots
recipes.summary: Creamy tomato chicken with cardamom, gluten free.
steps: Melt the butter, cook the onion 5 minutes, add garlic and ginger, then the spices.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes, then blend smooth.
Add the chicken and simmer 15 minutes until 75°C, then stir in the cream.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C throughout.

recipes.title: Lamb Keema and Peas
recipes.summary: Dry-spiced lamb mince with peas and ginger, served with basmati rice, gluten free.
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil 5 minutes, add the spices.
Add the lamb and brown 8 minutes, breaking up.
Add tomato and 1/2 cup water and simmer 10 minutes, add peas.
Cook until lamb reaches 75°C. Cook rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook lamb mince to 75°C with no pink.

recipes.title: Egg Curry with Coconut Rice
recipes.summary: Boiled eggs in a coconut-tomato curry, gluten free.
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes until hard, cool and peel.
Fry onion, garlic, ginger 5 minutes, add curry powder, tomato and coconut milk, simmer 10 minutes.
Add the eggs and heat through.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, serve with coriander.
notes: Food safety: boil eggs until the yolk is firm.

recipes.title: Coconut Beef Rice Noodle Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Beef strips stir-fried with basil, chilli and tamari over rice noodles, gluten free.
steps: Soak or cook the noodles per the packet until tender, drain.
Stir-fry beef in hot oil 2 minutes until browned and 63°C inside, remove.
Fry garlic and chilli 30 seconds until fragrant, add noodles, tamari, fish sauce, sugar.
Return beef, toss with basil.
notes: Food safety: cook beef strips to at least 63°C inside.

recipes.title: Lemongrass Chicken Rice Plates
recipes.summary: Charred lemongrass chicken with cucumber and rice, gluten free.
steps: Marinate chicken with lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar, tamari.
Cook rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Grill 8 minutes each side until charred and 75°C.
Slice and serve with rice, cucumber and mint.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C throughout.
Plus 1 hour marinating.

recipes.title: Vegan Rice Paper Rolls with Peanut Dipping
recipes.summary: Tofu and herb rolls with peanut dip, vegan and gluten free.
steps: Cook the vermicelli per the packet until tender and drain.
Soften a wrapper in warm water until pliable, fill with tofu, vegetables, herbs, noodles and roll tightly.
Whisk peanut butter, tamari, lime juice and a splash of water until smooth for dipping.

recipes.title: Glazed Shiitake and Edamame over Sushi Rice
recipes.summary: Glazed mushrooms and edamame over rice, vegan.
steps: Cook rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Sear mushrooms in oil 6 minutes until golden.
Add teriyaki sauce and edamame, cook 2 minutes.
Serve over rice with sesame seed and spring onion.

recipes.title: Peanut Noodle Lunch Bowls
recipes.summary: Wheat noodles with peanut sesame coating, cabbage and carrot, vegan.
steps: Cook noodles per packet until tender, drain and rinse.
Whisk peanut butter, soy, vinegar, sesame oil and a little warm water until smooth.
Toss with noodles, carrot, cabbage.
Top with spring onion and peanuts.

recipes.title: Sweet Chilli Tofu Lettuce Cups
recipes.summary: Crisp tofu cubes tossed in sweet chilli and wrapped in lettuce, vegan.
steps: Fry tofu in the oil for 8 minutes until crisp.
Add sweet chilli and soy sauce, toss.
Spoon into lettuce leaves, top with carrot, mint and peanuts.

recipes.title: Lentil Dhal Samosa Rolls
recipes.summary: Baked spring roll wrapper rolls of spiced red lentil, vegan.
steps: Simmer lentils in water 12 minutes until thick, drain extra.
Fry onion and ginger in oil 4 minutes, add curry powder, mix with lentils and coriander.
Roll in wrappers and brush with oil.
Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until crisp.
